payload.title: Farm-signal incidents were never opened: alert_incidents.rule_id is uuid while every signal identifies itself by a synthetic key, and the alarm row is saved before the failing incident write, so each redelivery re-wrote it (one poison message produced ~20,000 alarm rows over its 7-day delivery budget); MealUnderfed fired once per delivery instead of once per unit per day
evidence: apps/alert-engine/src/database/migrations/1800000000000-Baseline.ts:22 (rule_id uuid NOT NULL, FK to alert_rules)
apps/alert-engine/src/database/entities/alert-incident.entity.ts:100 (ruleId: string, plus an unused ManyToOne on the same column)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/services/feeding-execution-alert.service.ts:54 (alarm saved, then ensureIncident outside any shared transaction)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/services/farm-signal-incident.service.ts:92 (ensureIncident, first query is findOne where ruleId)
payload.rule_violated: A signal's alarm and the incident it feeds commit atomically and idempotently; the DB column type is the one the entity declares
payload.notes: Fixed by migration 1824200000000 (rule_id text, FK dropped), FarmSignalIncidentService.raise (one transaction, unique (rule_id, source_event_id) key, escalation after commit) and a per-unit-per-day key for MealUnderfed. mortality / low-stock / water-quality / FCR / feed-coverage still use ensureIncident: tracked separately.
narrative: Production 2026-10-26: alert_history holds 99,5 thousand rows for the test tenant (mortality x2, water-quality, low-stock x2, 7 days each, plus one live loop); alert_incidents holds 0 rows; aqua-alert logs 'invalid input syntax for type uuid: "system:meal-underfed:..."' every ~30 s.
